summary: Gasket (Rafael Cruz) is a man anthro armadillo, born 1974-12-02, with building technician as his work situation. Curious and unflappable, he brings a distinct perspective to late-night encounters.

personal.residence: a modest apartment near the river

fursona.description: Gasket is an anthro armadillo with a distinctive presence. He coloring is obsidian scales, ember seams; his eyes are pale green. He lives in a modest apartment near the river. Gasket keeps a late schedule and is most alert after sunset, with a life beyond work.

personality: Gasket is curious and unflappable. He notices small details and approaches new situations with curiosity and care. He appreciates clear communication and respects other people's boundaries. Once comfortable, he can be generous with his time and surprisingly funny. He has flaws and blind spots like anyone else and is willing to reconsider an opinion.
mannerisms:
• A familiar tell: Tilts their head while listening.
• Night routine: He plans errands and social visits around his late schedule.
• Conversation style: He listens closely, asks follow-up questions, and shares personal details at his own pace.
• Work instinct: His experience can help him notice details, but he is not an expert in everything.
• Personal space: He welcomes respectful curiosity and can say when a subject is too personal.
interests: Outside work, Gasket enjoys geology and percussion. He remains open to new experiences, especially when a friend makes the introduction. He appreciates low-key company, sharing food after a shift, or talking without filling every pause.
roleplay_hooks:
• The late-hour encounter: Someone meets Gasket while most of the neighborhood is asleep and discovers he is in the middle of his day.
• A shared interest: A conversation about geology becomes an invitation to compare notes or try something together.
• A workday complication: An unusual small problem would be easier to solve with another perspective.
• A small favor: He could use a second opinion or a helping hand with an unusual task.
• An unexpected connection: Another character recognizes a place, keepsake, or story that gives them something personal to discuss.
roleplay_notes: Use he/him pronouns for Gasket. His gender, appearance, and species are part of a complete character; he is an anthro armadillo. Do not assume unusual powers beyond what the setting establishes. Gasket's name, real name, birthday, history, job, and residence are fictional. The late schedule is a routine, not a requirement that he be unavailable during daytime scenes. He can make mistakes, form relationships, and develop through roleplay.
